## History

Peter Sloane was a member of the Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers) when the group faced a major setback. After a mix-up with paint order numbers caused the local hall to be painted glaring blue instead of green, he and the other young people in the society received the support of the villagers, who blamed the [Pyes](../codex/factions.md#pyes) for the mistake.

_Sources: [v2 IX A Question of Color P0](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0000), [v2 IX A Question of Color P25](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0025), [v2 IX A Question of Color P32](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0032), [v2 IX A Question of Color P40](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0040)_
